$comment: Absolute limits for the perf CI job, set from its first run on macos-15-intel (UI with the CPU slowed 2x, software rendering, so scrolling is far below a real Mac's 60 fps). The job also fails when a metric is more than 10% worse than the base branch measured on the same runner (5% for JavaScript size, 15% for the scan). Lower is better except scrollFpsMin.
